disposition_vocabulary.mechanical_patch: Documented mechanical translation emitted and receipt verified.
disposition_vocabulary.mechanical_patch_pending: A documented syntax/primitive translation is required; no output receipt exists.
disposition_vocabulary.provenance_copy: Exact provenance copy emitted and receipt verified.
disposition_vocabulary.provenance_copy_pending: Exact archival copy is planned under provenance; no output receipt exists.
disposition_vocabulary.semantic_adapter: Documented semantic adapter emitted and receipt verified.
disposition_vocabulary.semantic_adapter_pending: A documented behavior-preserving Hermes adapter is required; no output receipt exists.
disposition_vocabulary.verbatim_copy: Exact copy emitted and receipt verified.
disposition_vocabulary.verbatim_copy_pending: Exact copy is planned; no output receipt exists.

schema.emitted_output_rule: output_state=emitted requires a verified output_sha256 and output_mode receipt.
schema.patch_rule: Every patch_ids value must resolve in provenance/patches/index.json.
schema.pending_output_rule: output_state=pending requires output_sha256 and output_mode to be null.
schema.row_identity: Exactly one row per upstream regular file, keyed by source_path.
schema.target_rule: Every port_target is unique, repository-relative, path-safe, and preserves its first-class upstream component.
